adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a real issue in addGuests.handler.ts. Looking at the diff: line 92-109 shows `prisma.booking.update()` which persists the new guests to the database. Then at line 165, `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` is called which can fail. If the calendar update fails, the guests are already in the database. On retry, the `uniqueGuests` filter at lines 72-76 will filter out all guests (since they're now in booking.attendees), causing `uniqueGuests.length === 0` to throw at line 78. This creates a permanent inconsistency between the database and external calendar with no way to recover via retry.
